defect_observations.detail: Durrett's Thm 2.1.22 sketch (p. 54) declares phi_o composed with psi the coding without an image or inverse argument ('Caveat emptor'). The handbook adds H = closure of S and an explicit Borel image and inverse, and defines standard Borel as coding onto a Borel subset, which is stronger than the source's 'nice' wording (1-1 map into R, both directions measurable). The variant is stated explicitly at lines 174-180; reviewers should confirm the stronger definition is intended.
